Accumulates the selected costs. / 正确累计符合条件的价格。
Counts exactly the selected items. / 正确统计符合条件的商品数。

Initializes a valid candidate from the nonempty list. / 从非空列表初始化候选人。
Visits all players without modifying the list. / 遍历所有玩家且不改变列表。
Computes absolute distance from targetScore. / 计算与目标分数的绝对差。

7.name: WordGrid
parts: countOrderedRows
Visits every row. / 遍历每一行。
Checks all adjacent pairs within valid column bounds. / 在合法下标范围比较相邻字符串。
Uses string lengths and accepts equal lengths. / 比较长度并允许相等。

parts: Part (a): isWordChain
Traverses all adjacent pairs with valid indices. / 合法遍历所有相邻词对。
Checks that the later word contains the previous word. / 检查后词包含前词。
Returns false when any pair fails. / 任一不符合时返回false。
Returns true only after all pairs pass without modifying wordList. / 全部通过才返回true且不改原列表。

Visits all original words in order. / 按原顺序遍历所有词。

Removes exactly the initial occurrence using substring. / 只移除开头的target。
Adds all matching suffixes, including empty strings, without modifying wordList. / 保留空后缀且不改原列表。

12.name: BoxOfCandy
parts: Part (a): moveCandyToFirstRow

Searches the other rows in the specified column. / 搜索该列其他行。

Traverses rows from last to first. / 自底向上遍历行。
Traverses each row left to right. / 每行从左到右遍历。

Accumulates every difficulty value. / 累加所有难度。
Calls both provided extreme-value helper methods and subtracts one of each. / 调用两个辅助方法各减一个极值。
Divides by length - 2 using floating-point arithmetic. / 用浮点数计算去掉两个值后的平均数。
Returns the correct label at the 50 and 70 boundaries. / 正确处理50和70边界。

Compares every adjacent pair with valid indices. / 合法比较所有相邻项。
Uses nondecreasing order, permitting equality. / 允许相等。
Returns the correct Boolean result without changing the array. / 不改数组且正确返回布尔结果。

Provides public double gameLength() (or compatible numeric return type) and identifies private per-question time storage. / 给出公开数值返回方法头及题目预计时间私有字段。
Explains initializing that field in TriviaQuestion constructors and adding a public accessor, so TriviaGame can total the values. / 说明构造器初始化及公开访问器供游戏累计。

parts: Part (a): computeBonusThreshold

Finds the minimum. / 找到最小值。
Finds the maximum. / 找到最大值。
Removes one minimum and one maximum and divides by length - 2 with floating-point arithmetic. / 各减一个极值后计算浮点平均数。

Visits every employee index. / 遍历每位员工。

Applies a 10% bonus only above the threshold. / 仅严格超过阈值才加10%。

Counts consecutive values strictly above threshold. / 累计连续严格超过阈值的天数。
Resets the current count on other values. / 中断时清零。
Maintains the maximum, including a run ending at the last entry. / 包括末尾热浪在内更新最大值。
Returns the maximum length. / 返回最大长度。
